description: This file defines a Java interface TransactionRepository that extends Spring Data's CrudRepository to manage Transaction entities, including a custom method to find transactions by account number.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface for Transaction entities, providing basic CRUD operations and a custom method to find transactions by account number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing a list of Transaction objects associated with the specified account number.
